title: Toolchain smoke check (not an experiment, no research data)
outcome: First Typst compile failed: 'font fallback list must not be empty' (pandoc's typst template emits an empty font list). Fixed by passing -V mainfont="Libertinus Serif". Second attempt: 1-page PDF of the heading skeleton, text extractable, page visually inspected at 60 ppi. PDF kept in scratch only, not committed. uv lock resolved 15 packages; uv sync --frozen installed them; numpy 2.3.4, scipy 1.16.2, jsonschema 4.25.1 imported.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1

title: Smoke matrix of research/protocol.md section 7 (simulated; not evidence)
commands: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m trust.cli run --config experiments/smoke.json --quiet
PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m trust.cli report --dir results/exploratory/smoke --pdf
outcome: 6 runs (N = 50, nu in {3, 30}, sigma 1.0, 3 seeds), 0 failed, 0 degenerate flags. ORACLE tau-b = 1 in every run. Runtime per run mean 2.26 ms (max 3.66 ms). results.json byte-identical across three code revisions (05a4c5b working tree, 8a331fb, e1ad9bb). 3 seeds is too few to estimate the SD of D; see JRN-0003.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1

title: Variance and runtime pilot at the 4 corner cells of the EXP-001 grid (simulated; not evidence)
commands: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m trust.cli run --config experiments/pilot-exp001-corners.json --quiet
PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m trust.cli report --dir results/exploratory/pilot-exp001-corners --pdf
outcome: 40 runs (N = 200, nu in {3, 30} x sigma in {0.5, 1.5}, 10 seeds, seed namespace 901, disjoint from confirmatory namespaces 1 and 2), 0 failed, 0 degenerate flags. Runtime per run mean 3.30 ms, max 5.03 ms. Per-seed SD of D = tau_b(SHRINK_5) - tau_b(MEAN): 0.0064, 0.0072, 0.0103, 0.0128 by cell (planning assumption was 0.05). Per-cell bootstrap 95% half-widths 0.0038 to 0.0075 at 10 seeds. Sign of D differs by cell (negative at sigma 0.5, positive at sigma 1.5). LCB minus MEAN negative in every cell (-0.10 to -0.30). Share of zero-review products 0.255 at nu 3, 0.034 at nu 30. Planning observations only.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1

title: Variance pilot of the EXP-002 lambda contrast (simulated; not evidence)
commands: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m trust.cli run --config experiments/pilot-exp002-lambda.json --quiet
PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m trust.cli report --dir results/exploratory/pilot-exp002-lambda --pdf
outcome: 40 runs (N = 200, nu 3, sigma 1.0, lambda in {0, 2} x gamma in {-0.5, 0.5}, 10 seeds, seed namespace 902), 0 failed, 0 degenerate flags. Runtime per run mean 3.46 ms, max 5.03 ms. Per-seed SD of the paired lambda contrast D(lambda=2) - D(lambda=0): 0.0074 (gamma -0.5), 0.0073 (gamma 0.5); bootstrap 95% half-width about 0.0044 at 10 seeds, against the 0.03 planning threshold. lambda = 2 lowered the mean reported count from about 3.1 to about 2.1 and raised the zero-review share from about 0.27 to about 0.35.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1
